## Summary

What changes and why, in two or three sentences.

## Linked issue

Closes #

## Type of change

- [ ] feature
- [ ] fix
- [ ] chore / refactor
- [ ] docs
- [ ] ci / devops
- [ ] security

-
-

## How it was tested

Commands run and their outcome:

```
mvn -B verify
```

- [ ] Unit tests added or updated
- [ ] Integration tests added or updated
- [ ] Verified manually (describe below)

## Risk and rollback

- Does this change delete, overwrite, or migrate data? yes / no
- If yes: what protects existing data, and how is it restored?
- Rollback plan:

## Checklist

- [ ] CI is green
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, passwords, or real personal data in the diff
- [ ] No new endpoint is exposed through the gateway without authentication
- [ ] Documentation updated (README, docs/, API examples)
- [ ] Database changes are in a new Flyway migration, never an edited old one
- [ ] The review checklist in docs/review-checklist.md was walked through

## Reviewer notes

The reviewer leaves at least one specific, line-level comment, and states the decision: approve, request changes, or comment.
